steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Billing that adds up** in *Join traps and cross joins*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: JOIN prescriptions AS pr ON pr.appointment_id = i.appointment_id;

steps.title: Rebuild Billing that adds up cold
prompt: Return each **specialty** with its correct invoiced **revenue** and its number of **prescriptions**. Make sure revenue is not inflated by appointments that have several prescriptions.
- `doctors(id, name, specialty, ward_id, mentor_id)`: `ward_id` is NULL for a doctor without a ward; `mentor_id` points at another doctor
- `patients(id, name, born, ward_id)`: `ward_id` is NULL for outpatients
- `appointments(id, patient_id, doctor_id, day, status)`: status is `done`, `cancelled` or `booked`
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
